qualitative_claims.description: Management describes future 13 Taiwan advanced-process/packaging facilities and 5-6 overseas fabs, not 13+5-6 commissioned production units.
New Tainan N3 fab expected to start production 2027-H1; another N3 fab decided for 2028-H1. Planned ramps, not booked revenue.
2026-2028 capital spending expected materially above prior three-year period, but no total amount or FY2027/FY2028 allocations stated.
Arizona fab 2 planned 2027-Q3 and Japan fab 2 N3 planned 2028, not realized production.
